{{HEAD_CSS}}
memo: Shared head tags. {{HEAD_CSS}} is the tag that collects the CSS of pages and components and outputs it in order. For shared tracking tags, create a component containing the tracking code and select it under "Tracking component" in Site settings; it is then inserted into the head of every page.
